name: 307 Meat Processing
old_description: Our shop takes great pleasure in providing our community with quality products. We provide vacuum-sealed products for optimal freshness and longevity.
about:
307 Meat Processing operates from Mills, Wyoming, tracing its roots to the mid-1960s when it began as Pat's Meat, a seasonal wild game processing service run from a garage. The family-owned business has remained under family stewardship since its founding, evolving over decades into a full-service custom butcher shop serving central Wyoming.

The shop processes both domestic livestock and wild game, offering custom cutting, vacuum-sealed packaging rated for up to two years of freezer storage, and mobile slaughter services that travel to ranches and farms. Its in-house sausage production has earned local awards, and the facility handles everything from field-dressed antelope to beef sides for area ranchers.

Customers include local ranchers who rely on the mobile slaughter unit, hunters bringing in wild game such as antelope, and households purchasing domestic beef and pork. The company emphasizes collaboration with area producers and positions itself as a community-focused butcher for the Casper region.

Founded on a passion for butcher craftsmanship, the business distinguishes itself through vacuum-sealing technology that preserves freshness, on-site slaughter capability, and a family-run operation that has served the same region for over fifty years.
